title: results.json
description: One student's scores for the conversations in data/conversations.json. Two rules cannot be written in JSON Schema and are checked by viewer.html: each result's scores list has one entry per criterion, in the same order as criteria, and overall is the average of those scores rounded to two decimals.

model.description: The model that did the scoring, exactly as passed to the API.

criteria.description: The criteria of your rubric, in the order they appear in rubric.md.

description.description: The text under that heading, including what a 1, a 3 and a 5 look like.

results.description: One entry per scored conversation. A conversation whose API call failed is left out.

overall.description: The average of this conversation's scores, rounded to two decimals.

scores.description: One entry per criterion, in the same order as criteria.

criterion.description: The criterion's name, identical to its name in criteria.

reason.description: One sentence from the judge giving the evidence for the score. Once in a while the judge returns an empty reason, and that is allowed.
